verdict.rationale: The IRS documents a system-to-system machine channel, Modernized e-File, that "uses the widely accepted Extensible Markup Language (XML) format." It also documents an IRIS Application-to-Application intake for information returns, so an XML-defined machine rail exists. However, the evidence never shows the XML schemas or a data dictionary actually being published, and the access described is a credentialed provider rail. Probes found no OpenAPI spec at any candidate path. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of published XML schemas/XSDs or a data dictionary for MeF/IRIS A2A, documentation of how developers obtain them, any OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
